content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the payment infrastructure is severely restricted, digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-trap-most|creators]] have been locked out of platforms like Stripe, leaving them with no choice but to abandon their businesses or risk losing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-courses-without-teachable-stripe-what-actually-how-2|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-courses-without-2|Everything You]]. This is not just a Zimbabwean problem, but a global issue affecting millions of entrepreneurs in countries where traditional payment gateways are unavailable or heavily regulated. The consequences are dire: lost revenue, abandoned projects, and a stifled economy. But there is hope – a sovereign commerce infrastructure that empowers creators to build and deploy their own digital stores, free from the shackles of platform dependence.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH solution is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives digital creators control over their businesses. By leveraging free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This infrastructure is not just resistant to platform failures, but also provides a scalable and secure foundation for growth.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to gather a few essential tools and information. First, you'll need a GitHub account to host your store on GitHub Pages. Next, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account to handle crypto transactions. You'll also need to have your digital products ready to be uploaded to your store. Lastly, you'll need to familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides a step-by-step guide to deploying your store. Don't worry, the deployment process is straightforward and can be completed in just 4-6 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have your tools and information in order, it's time to set up your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves configuring NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and setting up Supabase to store order information. You'll also need to configure Cloudflare Pages to deliver your digital products instantly to customers. With this pipeline in place, you'll be able to process transactions and deliver products to customers seamlessly.
Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages can be done in just 4-6 hours using the Sovereign Blueprint.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After setting up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves deploying your store on GitHub Pages and configuring Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming traffic. You'll also need to test your NOWPayments integration to ensure that payments are being processed correctly. Once you're live, you can start promoting your store and processing transactions. Remember, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers end-to-end testing and 30-day support for a hassle-free deployment experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is up and running, it's time to scale and grow your business. This involves upgrading your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and adding more products to your store. You can also use the Sovereign Blueprint to optimize your store's performance and reduce costs. With the right infrastructure in place, you can focus on what matters most – creating and selling your digital products.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The most important question on every digital creator's mind is: can I really deploy a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free? The answer is yes – with the COREMERCH solution, you can deploy a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, without relying on restrictive payment gateways like Stripe. This is made possible by leveraging free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. With the Sovereign Blueprint, you can deploy your store in just 4-6 hours and start processing transactions instantly.
NOWPayments offers a 0.5% fee for crypto transactions, as well as support for 300+ cryptocurrencies.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store, follow these concrete steps: Create a GitHub account and set up a NOWPayments account; Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint and deploy your store in 4-6 hours; Configure NOWPayments to accept crypto payments and set up Supabase to store order information; Deploy your store on GitHub Pages and configure Cloudflare Workers to handle incoming traffic; Test your NOWPayments integration to ensure that payments are being processed correctly.
